_comment: Grow's Nahw world: al-Ajurrumiyya, part by part (a few babs each), lesson by lesson. Hand-written. Every `ar` and `source` is the book's own words, from backend/data/books/openiti/<file>; src/lib/bookLesson.test.js checks each, and that a `whole` part quotes every paragraph of its babs (`kitabs`, the book's headings). `en` and `why` are our English.
_cards: teach {title, ar, en} · choose {ask, ar?, options, answer: index, arabic-options?, source, why} — an `ar` with ____ is a gap the answer fills · pick {ask, options: [{text, right?}], source, why} · sort {ask, into, items: [[text, bucket]], source, why} · order {ask, steps (in the right order), source, why}. `source` may be one quote or a list.
author: Ibn Ajurrum (d. 723 AH)

parts.title: The raised nouns
